short_description: Holter ECG database from Japan, containing data from 100 unique patients with paroxysmal AF including expert annotations of Supraventricular arrhythmias at the beat level.
title: SHDB-AF: a Japanese Holter ECG database of atrial fibrillation
abstract: Saitama Heart Database Atrial Fibrillation (SHDB-AF) is a novel open-sourced Holter ECG database from Japan, containing data from 122 unique subjects with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Among the 128 recordings, 98 contain raw ECG data with rhythm annotations at the beat level, manually performed by a cardiology fellow. abstract: This database includes 25 long-term ECG recordings of human subjects with atrial fibrillation (mostly paroxysmal).

title: Intracardiac Atrial Fibrillation Database
abstract: This database consists of endocardial recordings from the right atria of 8 patients in atrial fibrillation or flutter. A decapolar catheter with 2-5-2mm spacing (7mm spacing between bipoles) was placed in four separate regions of the heart. In each region, the 5 bipolar signals were recorded along with 3 surface ECG leads.

abstract: The fifth annual PhysioNet/Computers in Cardiology Challenge focusses on this question: Is it possible to predict if (or when) an episode of atrial fibrillation will end spontaneously?
